avoid: Over-extension of the lower back during bucking
children.game_version: A 'Follow the Leader' game where the 'Captain' creates a 4-count move for the line.

seniors.counts: Use 4-count movements instead of rapid 1-count snaps.
seniors.seated_version: Perform arm thrusts and 'Salt and Pepper' knee lifts while seated in a sturdy chair.
seniors.standing_version: Use a ballet barre or chair back for balance during marching steps.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Reduce tempo to 80 BPM and limit the depth of the pelvic buck.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Sharp, angular arm thrusts that often mirror the rhythmic 'bucking' of the torso.
movement_profile.footwork: High-stepping marching; the 'Salt and Pepper' requires lifting the bent knee until the foot is level with the standing knee.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Linear rows that shift into complex geometric patterns similar to marching band drills.
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: The 'buck' involves a rapid, powerful forward thrust of the pelvis and chest.
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Primarily upright, but includes deep squats during bucking sequences; no major aerial jumps.
movement_profile.partnering: None; primarily a group danceline format with a lead-and-follow structure.
movement_profile.posture: Upright and proud, with a strong, engaged core to support explosive thrusts.

signature_moves.description: Powerful body and arm thrusts derived from traditional African dance.
signature_moves.name: Bucking

signature_moves.description: A prance step featuring high-knee lifts where the foot reaches the opposite knee.
signature_moves.name: Salt and Pepper

movement_profile.tempo_feel: Staccato and high-velocity; movements are snapped into place.
movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Avoid soft or fluid movements; J-Setting requires extreme sharpness and 'snap' in every transition.

music_profile.musical_form: AABB or verse-chorus arrangements of popular funk, R&B, or hip-hop songs.
music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Heavy emphasis on the downbeat with syncopated brass stabs.
music_profile.sound_description: The sound is dominated by the 'Sonic Boom'—a massive, brass-heavy marching band sound with a thunderous percussion section that provides a constant, driving pulse for the dancers.
music_profile.vocal_style: Often accompanied by rhythmic chants or shouts from the dancers.

basic_steps: J-Sette Walk: A stylized marching step used for transitions.
Salt and Pepper: High-knee lift bringing the foot to the height of the opposite knee.
Bucking: Explosive pelvic and torso thrusts synchronized with arm movements.
The Strut: A confident, rhythmic walk with emphasized hip movement.
Tip Toe: A specialized marching technique performed on the balls of the feet.
teaching.formation: Three rows based on height: Short & Sassy, Magnificent Middle, and Tall & Tough.
teaching.level_notes: Requires high cardiovascular endurance and explosive core strength.
teaching.rhythm: Highly syncopated, following the percussive 'boom' of a marching band.
